title: fix(plugin-sharing): the declared-rule organization walk ends on the rows read; ADR-0131 small carriers retire the NULL-means-global texts
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3X7qDVRkhCrq8R4os9DMy3)_

Claim 6346494581 (`domain:engine` seat 2, card thread `session_01M7Q2xAsaBG8KpAYgUxtSdU`). Items 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8 of the card. Item 4 landed with #25210. Item 5 is a governed `.claude/**` line and goes to the skills lane. Items 9 and 10 (comment 6345275520) wait on #25246 and are not in this claim. So this PR is `Part of #25203`, not `Fixes`: the card stays open for items 5, 9 and 10 (seat correction after the contract review).

## What changed

**Item 1, the one behaviour change: `resolveDeclaredRuleScopes` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts`).**
- Before: the keyset walk over `sys_organization` filtered each page to string ids, then tested the FILTERED page for "short page, stop". A full page of 500 rows holding one row with no readable `id` read as short, so the walk ended there and answered a partial list. The boot sweep then revoked the declared-rule grants of every organization past that page.
- Now: the walk ends on the number of rows READ. A page holding a row whose `id` the walk cannot read answers unknown (`null`), with a warning that names the cause, as the epic's plan amendment 6254164222 prescribes ("treat a filtered-out id as a failed read"). The caller already treats `null` as UNKNOWN: no declared rule is served, and no declared rule's grant is revoked.
- Hardening, not a reachable defect: `sys_organization.id` is a text field, so no shipped install produces such a row.
- Pin: `sharing-rule.test.ts`, "a FULL page holding a row with no readable id answers unknown (null) …". 1201 organizations, row 10 of the first page loses its id.

**Item 2, wording.**
- `18.sharing-rule-declared-mirror-retired.ts` `reason`: the D13 paraphrase. ADR-0131 D13 asks an ADR-0087 entry of every retirement **of an authorable shape**. The text now says this entry is registered by choice, because the seeder is not one. (The reconciliation's suggested text named a card number; the repo's runtime-string rule keeps tracker numbers out of shipped text, so the sentence carries the reason instead.)
- `18.driver-read-scope-follows-tenant-wall.ts` `surface`: names update and delete "by id or by predicate".
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts`: the printed warning "(but on a table whose column is not the tenancy anchor): assign …" now reads ", except on a table whose column is not the tenancy anchor. Assign …". The same idiom is fixed in the comment above `unattributableHeld` and in the `heldUnattributable` docblock (`organization-ownership-apply.ts`).

**Item 3, texts of the retired NULL-means-global reading.**
- `sys-user-position.object.ts`: the docblock and the Organization help. An assignment applies only while its organization is the active one, and an organization-less row applies nowhere (`grantAppliesInTenant`, `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`).
- `sys-user-permission-set.object.ts`: the Organization help ("Optional organization scope. NULL = applies in every org context." → "The organization this grant belongs to.").
- `plugin-security`'s `en` bundle was regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. The `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` values are hand-written and were updated to match, because merge mode keeps translated values.
- "simply unstamped": the text lives in `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` (the `IEmailService` `organizationId` TSDoc), not in `plugin-email`. It now says the engine stamps the organization it can derive or refuses the insert (ADR-0131 D9), and leaves the row unstamped only in a composition with no organization object.
- `packages/verify/src/harness.ts`, `inviteForAudienceGate`: the dedicated organization id hides these invitations from fixtures under a wall only. On `single` an organization owner's read returns them too.
- Forced companion: `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/empty-state-registry.mts` loses its `sys_user_permission_set.organization_id` row. That row classified the "NULL = applies in every org context" statement this card removes, and `check:empty-state` reds `STALE — registered, but the statement is gone` without the removal (measured).

**Item 6.** `schedule-organization.zod.ts` cited the deleted `objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts` ledger. It now cites `service-automation/src/suspended-run-store.ts`, where the store stamps a run's row. `content/docs/references/automation/schedule-organization.mdx` was regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, then re-checked green).

**Item 7.** `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`, the gate order's second item: the engine sets `bypassTenantAudit` on an `isSystem` write only where the object's schema puts it out of scope (no tenant field, or federated), as `buildDriverOptions` does today.

**Item 8.** `delivery-claim-tenant-audit.integration.test.ts`: the docblock quoted the driver's old warning tail. It now quotes the opening and says the prescription after the dash has been reworded. The assertions are unchanged.

## Tests

At head `0a71e50d7`:
- `plugin-sharing` `pnpm test`: 53 files, 1201 tests passed.
- `plugin-security` `pnpm test`: 208 files, 4274 passed, 45 skipped.
- `cli` unit tier, `organization-ownership` files: 8 files, 76 passed.
- `spec` `src/migrations` + `scripts/liveness`: 17 files, 579 passed.
- `typecheck`: plugin-sharing, plugin-security, cli, verify, service-messaging, spec, all exit 0.
- Ablation of item 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the old filtered-page block put back): the new pin went red (1 failed, 5 passed), every other `resolveDeclaredRuleScopes` test stayed green. Restore verified: blob equal to `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite imports `./sharing-plugin.js` from `src`, so no `dist` leg applies.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `0a71e50d7` derived 124 families. `--ran` reconciliation: 122 run, all exit 0; 2 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met on this checkout), left to CI: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a whole-workspace build) and `check:i18n-coverage` (one of 14 configs could not lint here). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:skill-examples` first exited 3 on missing prerequisites (a pinned fixture commit, the client builds) and exited 0 once those were fetched and built.

## Acceptance notes

Published text, per item:
- Item 1: `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` behaviour and a new warning string. Published.
- Item 2: the two semantic entries ship in `@objectstack/spec`'s upgrade guide and registry. Published. No check reads their wording, and `check:upgrade-guide` / `check:spec-changes` are green. The cli warning is a runtime string in `@objectstack/cli`. Published. The two cli comments are not.
- Item 3: the two `description`s and the four locale bundles ship in `@objectstack/plugin-security`. Published. The `IEmailService` TSDoc ships in `@objectstack/spec`'s `.d.ts`. Published. The position docblock and the `verify` comment are not published.
- Item 6: the TSDoc is in a `*.zod.ts`, which `@objectstack/spec` ships verbatim (`files` includes `src/**/*.zod.ts`). Published. The reference page is docs.
- Items 7 and 8: docs and a test comment. Not published.
- One `patch` changeset covers the four published packages (`Metadata-protocol: none`).

Not changed here (no drive-by): the `sys-user-permission-set.object.ts` docblock still calls an organization-less grant "platform-wide" when it explains the unique index's NULL-safety; `tenant-audit-census.mdx` keeps its historical narrative about the old mute further down. Neither is named by the card.

Cross-lane declarations (not claims): `domain:cli` on #22648 (6346689477), `domain:devx` on #20163 (6346705267, for `content/docs`, which the lane table assigns to devx), `domain:spec` on #18549 (6346927889), `domain:services` on #21118 (6346947858, `plugin-sharing`, `plugin-security`, `service-messaging`).
